# Salvavidas Pharma

> > WHO-GMP certified pharmaceutical manufacturer and exporter from India specializing in APIs, finished dosage forms, and contract manufacturing for global markets.

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO-certified pharmaceutical company offering comprehensive manufacturing services including bulk drug APIs, tablets, capsules, injectables, and syrups. The company serves markets across Asia, Africa, Latin America, CIS, and North America with USFDA and EMA compliant manufacturing facilities.
